headline: The jailed mayor of Tirana, Albania, sent voters a video of an AI version of himself promising free school meals from his prison cell.
score_reason: Pool score kept; the facts match the headline, but it was read through a relayed report.
importance_line: It affects Tirana voters and shows how jailed politicians can still reach the public through AI doubles, after similar cases with Imran Khan and Jair Bolsonaro; Veliaj denies the corruption allegations.
summary: Politico reports, as relayed by Vijesti.me, that Erion Veliaj, mayor of Tirana, Albania's capital, posted an Instagram video marked as AI-generated in which his digital double promises free school meals 'even from this cell'. Veliaj has been jailed since early 2025 over corruption and financial crime investigations, which he denies, and he remains officially mayor until local elections in the first half of 2027.
